description: Full funnel: fresh user signs in, completes onboarding, runs an injury assessment through AI analysis, generates a rehab plan, completes a guided workout, then reviews Progress.
preSeed: none — everything generated live so all funnel events fire organically

journey.expect: [VirtualUser] signed in as vuser-happy-path-001 in logs

journey.action: tap through IntroCarouselView to completion (part of real funnel — no skip arg exists in production path)
complete all onboarding steps: basic info (name, DOB, sex, height, weight), injury history (none), surgical history (none), medical history (none), activity level (Moderate), review & submit
open body map, select right knee region
fill essential pain fields (aching, intensity 6, 2 weeks, intermittent, gradual onset, aggravated by stairs, relieved by rest) and run analysis
from analysis result, open preferences sheet (no equipment, 30 min, moderate) and generate plan
start workout from plan, complete 2 sets of first exercise, skip second exercise, finish workout
switch to Progress tab, view charts

aiCalls: analysis + analysis_verify + rehab_plan (one full pipeline run — budgeted)
